# {{ site.Title }}

> {{ site.Params.description }}

{{ site.Title }} is the personal site of {{ site.Params.author }}. Essays are original writing. The research section is an annotated transcript of Tyler Cowen's conversation with Daron Acemoglu, with 18 "rabbit hole" pages that Adam researched in conversation with AI models; treat them as a reading companion, not an independently verified source. {{ with (site.GetPage "/notes").Pages.ByDate }}Notes are short posts imported from LinkedIn ({{ (index . 0).Date.Year }}–{{ (index . (sub (len .) 1)).Date.Year }}) and preserved as written.{{ end }}
